_doc: E168: the Steam trailer's sound design layer (the in-game sounds come from public/assets/sfx/). Every family is generated with MOSS-SoundEffect v2 and Stable Audio 3 Medium; the better take (CLAP rank) is used. `desc` is the CLAP ranking text.

tr-whoosh.desc: a fast cinematic whoosh swooshing past
tr-whoosh.prompt: A single fast cinematic transition whoosh: air rushing past the camera from left to right, a rising swoosh that peaks and cuts off cleanly. Trailer sound design, no music.

tr-braam.desc: a huge deep cinematic brass braam impact
tr-braam.prompt: A huge, deep cinematic trailer braam: one massive distorted low brass blast with a sub-bass boom, sustaining and decaying into a long hall reverb tail. Trailer sound design.

tr-riser.desc: a rising tension riser building up to a peak
tr-riser.prompt: A cinematic tension riser: a rising, accelerating swell of shimmering strings and reversed noise that climbs in pitch for four seconds and stops abruptly at its peak. Trailer sound design, no melody.

tr-impact.desc: a massive cinematic boom impact hit
tr-impact.prompt: A massive cinematic impact hit: a deep drum boom and metallic slam with a sub-bass drop, followed by a long, dark reverberant tail fading to silence. Trailer sound design.

tr-subdrop.desc: a deep sub bass drop rumble
tr-subdrop.prompt: A deep sub-bass drop: a low boom that falls in pitch and rumbles away over three seconds. Cinematic trailer sound design, nothing else.

tr-reverse.desc: a reversed cymbal swell rising into a hit
tr-reverse.prompt: A reversed cymbal swell: a crash cymbal played backwards, swelling louder over two seconds and cutting off sharply. Cinematic trailer transition, nothing else.

tr-sword.desc: a sword blade slicing through the air with a metallic ring
tr-sword.prompt: A heavy steel sword swung fast through the air: a sharp whoosh with a bright metallic ring of the blade. Close, clean, cinematic, no music.

tr-gallop.prompt: Several horses galloping fast across open grassland, thundering hooves passing close by, wind. Cinematic, no music.
